title: A day at the library
question: How does a reader move from finding a book to joining a reading group?
summary: Follow a reader through five places, from home to a shared reading session.

sources.title: Regional library service — example operating brief

entities.label: Reader home
entities.description: The reader leaves home for a day of borrowing and a reading group.
entities.constraint: The group meets in the afternoon.

entities.label: Welcome desk
entities.description: Staff help the reader choose a collection and explain today’s activities.
entities.constraint: The collection is in a separate building.

entities.label: Book collection
entities.description: The reader borrows a book selected with the collection team.
entities.constraint: The book must be available on the shelf.

entities.label: Reading garden
entities.description: The reader takes a break in the garden before the group begins.
entities.constraint: The path connects the library buildings.

entities.label: Reading room
entities.description: Readers meet around tables for a shared reading session.
entities.constraint: The facilitator opens the session at the announced time.

scenarios.label: Find a book, join a group
scenarios.summary: A five-place journey through the neighbourhood.
scenarios.condition: The collection and reading room are open.
scenarios.outcome: The reader arrives with a borrowed book and joins the group.
